description.text: AI-written synthesis of the official page retrieved in this pass, prepared by the collecting assistant: Helping tech startups disrupt the world since 2009 In the making of a great company, founders make all the big calls. And investors play the supporting roles. As prior founders ourselves, we started AppWorks to play that role. So you can count on our support. We love founders with passion, grit, and determination. We want to be the first investor to fund you and we want to help you go all the way. STATE OF THE APPWORKS NETWORK 663 ACTIVE STARTUPS 2,189 FOUNDERS 28,581 EMPLOYEES $ 8.1 B TOTAL RAISE $ 42.1 B TOTAL VALUATION $ 18.6 B ANNUAL REVENUES AppWorks offers tailored support for founders across different stages of their journey. Through AppWorks Accelerator, we partner with startups from early to growth stages, providing the resources, mentorship, and community to help them scale. Our AppWorks Funds offer financing to further accelerate growth and long-term success. Started in 2010, AppWorks Accelerator is a turbo engine built for seed-stage startups and your connection to our network of 663 startups and 2,189 founders, one of the largest of its kind in Asia. Join one of the largest communities of founders in the region With 4 funds at US$350 million of total fund size, AppWorks can go from a US$200K seed round all the way to leading with $15 million into a C round. As one of the most active early-stage VCs in Greater Southeast Asia, we fund 20-30 deals a year.
